positions.description:
Digital Charging Solutions is an e-mobility service provider with one of the largest charging networks in Europe. I joined the company to help unlock new business opportunities and expand the product portfolio. As a result of my 6-month internship, I was proud to announce that my team and I had launched Green Charging. With Green Charging, customers of Germany's largest OEMs can charge their vehicles with 100% renewable energy (RE) from local suppliers, contributing to the enhancement of RE economics and its expansion.

In addition to Green Charging, I was responsible for identifying new business opportunities in smart charging and V2G domains. After conducting a comprehensive market analysis, I prepared business case calculations, proposed a go-to-market strategy, and developed a product roadmap. 

In parallel with the project work, I prepared monthly profitability reports and competitors' benchmarks. I assisted managers in preparing marketing presentations and communicating with partners from automotive OEMs.
